headline: STRING-neighbor imputation for the 28 unscreened targets — 18 recovered with real signature shape
hypotheses_preregistered: STRING-complex/pathway partners share perturbation deltas (validated in-corpus: median 36th discrimination percentile vs 50% random; strong-partner genes top 5%)
Neighbor-imputed deltas beat the hand-tuned fallback on nmae and pds for the 18 gated targets
next_steps: k008: heterogeneous per-cell knockdown (eta ~ N(1, ~0.4)) — measured Atlas eta spread ~1.1 median; fid is the dominant deficit
Context-conditioned calibration — map K562 signatures to target contexts
Learned Layer A — generalize perturbation signatures to unseen targets
Transport parameter sweep (knockdown_efficiency, attenuation, noise) — held out to avoid leaderboard overfit

provenance.data: VCC 2026 controls + Replogle K562 GWPS bulk + 2025 VCC validation Atlas + STRING v12 interactions (score>=0.5)

log: The 28 fallback genes are genuinely unscreened (absent from K562 GWPS, K562 essential, and RPE1 screens; no alias recovery). Neighbor imputation from STRING partners recovered real signature shape for 18 of them (PSMB9->proteasome, TAF4->TFIID, MAPK7->MAP2K5/MEF2, MLKL->necroptosis). Score -0.0159 vs k006 -0.0210; nmae swung -0.074 -> +0.002; fid worsened slightly (-0.36 -> -0.40), sharpening the case that distribution shape — not signature means — is the deficit.
